Bug report: with the `toc` extension, a heading like `# Hello world !` gets the id `hello-world-`, with a trailing dash. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. report.answer: Fixed `slugify` in `markdown/extensions/toc.py` to strip leading and trailing separators from generated heading IDs so `# Hello world !` produces `hello-world` instead of `hello-world-`, added regression tests in `tests/test_syntax/extensions/test_toc.py`, and recorded the fix in `docs/changelog.md`.
